subject: general
question: Ustad Shafaat Ahmed Khan was best known for which of the following instrument?
solution:
The Correct answer is** Tabla**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tabla:**
 
• The Tabla is a percussive instrument consisting of a pair of hand drums used in the **traditional, classical, popular, and folk music of the Indian subcontinent.**
 
• It has been important in** Hindustani classical music since the 18th century and remains in use today.**
 
• **Ustad Shafaat Ahmed Khan** was a renowned Indian classical musician known for his virtuosity on the **tabla.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rudra Veena**:

 
 
• The Rudra Veena is a plucked string instrument used in **Hindustani classical music.**
 
• One of the oldest instruments in the world, the Rudra Veena is not as commonly played today but is revered for its deep, meditative sound.
 
 
 
• **Harmonium:**
 
 
• The Harmonium is a keyboard instrument that uses a** hand-pumped bellows to produce sound.**
 
• It is commonly used in Indian classical and folk music, as well as in popular music.
 
 
 
• **Violin**:
 
 
• The Violin is a **stringed instrument that is played with a bow.**
 
• It originated in Italy in the 16th century and has since been adopted worldwide.
 
• In Indian classical music, it has been adapted as a solo instrument, and it's widely used in Hindustani as well as in Carnatic music.
